plan: Implement Discover feature with paper feed, category filtering, pagination, and proper error handling; integrate Navigation 3 for Home/Discover tab switching.
steps: Create Paper data model (data/model/Paper.kt) with fields: id, title, authors (List<String>), field (category), abstract, likes
Create GetDiscoverFeedUseCase (domain/usecase/GetDiscoverFeedUseCase.kt) with mock papers across multiple fields (Physics, Biology, Chemistry, CS); support pagination and filtering
Create DiscoverUiState (discover/DiscoverUiState.kt) as sealed class with Loading, Success(papers, selectedCategory, hasMore), Error(message) states
Create DiscoverIntent (discover/DiscoverIntent.kt) with intents: LoadFeed, SelectCategory(field), LoadNextPage
Create DiscoverViewModel (discover/DiscoverViewModel.kt) that loads feed, handles category filtering (client-side), manages pagination, and exposes UiState

Create DiscoverScreen (discover/DiscoverScreen.kt) with LazyColumn showing paper cards; include category filter chips at top, paper card components showing title/authors/field, error state view, and empty state
Update MainActivity to integrate Navigation 3 with bottom navigation for Home and Discover tabs
Create DiscoverViewModelTest (test/discover/DiscoverViewModelTest.kt) with unit tests for feed loading, category filtering, and pagination
Create DiscoverHappyPathTest (androidTest/discover/DiscoverHappyPathTest.kt) with Espresso tests matching ticket requirements: feed loads, papers display, scroll pagination, category filtering
